description: Returns the account this connection acts in (an artist's, or a label's with its roster), what this connection is allowed to do, where the result is reviewed, and next_steps: what to offer the artist next, worked out from the account. Call this first, and again whenever you are unsure whose catalog you are working in. On a label connection, pass `artist` to see one roster artist's account.

artist.description: Only when you are connected as a label: the roster artist this call is for — their artist_user_id from list_roster, or their exact artist name. Required for every artist tool on a label connection. Leave it out on an artist's own connection.

name: whoami
title: Who this connection belongs to
